data: What is the value of the orange solid line at layer index 10 in the 'bert-base-uncased' plot?

The orange solid line represents the CKA-b metric. The layer index is along the x-axis, and the Pearson correlation values are along the y-axis. The orange solid line is the one we need to focus on for the 'bert-base-uncased' plot. At layer index 10, the orange solid line appears to be around 60.
